name: go-standards
description: Stdlib-grounded Go engineering standards for implementation, review, refactoring, and testing

interface.longDescription: Use Go Standards to implement, review, refactor, diagnose, and test Go code with standard-library-grade API, documentation, error-handling, compatibility, concurrency, and testing discipline. Targeted references provide self-contained examples and cover repository layout, Cobra commands, and typed Viper configuration.
defaultPrompt: Use $go-standards to implement or review this Go change with standard-library-grade API, test, and error-handling discipline.
